CheckTitle: Ensure Configuration Changes to HCM Security Profile Setups Are Monitored
Benchmark: CIS Oracle SaaS Cloud Applications Benchmark v1.0.0
RequiredAccess: Fusion Applications Security Console / Audit Reports (IT Security Manager)
Fusion Cloud Applications Risk Management (Advanced Controls)
Description: Changes to HCM security profiles, which grant access to sets of people or payroll data, should be audited and reviewed.
Risk: A profile change takes effect immediately for every holder and can expose sensitive HCM data.
AuditProcedure: Enable auditing for data roles and security profiles; review Audit Reports.
Automated alternative: deploy the matching Transaction/Access Controls in Fusion Cloud Applications Risk Management so changes start an investigation workflow. Examples: 60008-60011, 60015, 60016.

Steps: Review the affected transactions in Tools > Reports and Analytics, or monitor them continuously with Risk Management Transaction Controls.
